original_question: Which neurologist described ankylosing spondylitis in 1880, together with the neurologist who first described hereditary spastic paraplegia, sometimes called Strümpell-Lorrain disease?

final_qi.question: Which neurologist described ankylosing spondylitis in 1880, together with the neurologist who first described hereditary spastic paraplegia, sometimes called Strümpell-Lorrain disease?

final_qi.long_answer: Adolf von Strümpell is the neurologist who provided the first comprehensive description of hereditary spastic paraplegia (later known as Strümpell‐Lorrain disease) in 1880. His name is also associated with ankylosing spondylitis, sometimes referred to as Marie-Strümpell disease, indicating his significant contributions to the study of these neurological conditions.
